## Change

What triggers the problem, and what behavior does this change produce?

## Validation

List meaningful checks and results. Distinguish source tests, exact package
checks, synthetic replay and actual host/desktop observations.

## Remaining limits

Record untested host versions, pending human observations and any release gate.
Do not include private titles, paths, prompts, logs or credentials.

- [ ] Scope and architecture follow the current specification.
- [ ] Fixtures and test profiles are synthetic; no live installation was replaced.
- [ ] Required checks pass, or failures/deferrals are explicitly described.
- [ ] Documentation and upstream notices match the final behavior.
- [ ] Commits use the contributing human's own verified identity.
- [ ] No AI tool is listed as a commit co-author.
